versions.subject: feat: add more rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'curl.exe'
selection_cli:
    - CommandLine|re: '\s-k\s'
    - CommandLine|contains: '--insecure'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>\\s-k\\s)" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search Image="*\\curl.exe" OR OriginalFileName="curl.exe" CommandLineCondition="true" OR CommandLine="*--insecure*"
